definition: help given to someone who needs it
description: An indoor climbing gym with tall walls covered in colourful holds and thick blue mats on the floor. A young woman with long braids, in a mint crop top and black leggings, pushes off from below and climbs up the wall. A young woman with a dark ponytail, in a coral sports top and black leggings, crouches under her, rises and pushes her up from below with her hands, then stands watching and claps chalk off her hands. A chalk bag sits on the mat and other climbers stand in the background.

en.question: What is the woman with braids doing?

de.question: Was macht die Frau mit den Zöpfen?

es.answer: Está escalando un muro de escalada empinado.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer de las trenzas?

fr.answer: Elle escalade un mur d'escalade raide.
fr.question: Que fait la femme aux tresses ?
